case_name: Century Campus Housing Management, L.P. v. Elda Hana, LLC

issues.label: Standard for Rule 41(b) dismissal
issues.why: The court must apply the correct legal standard governing involuntary dismissal for failure to prosecute.

issues.label: Dismissal with prejudice justification
issues.why: Dismissal with prejudice is a harsh sanction requiring heightened justification and findings.

issues.label: Consideration of lesser sanctions
issues.why: The court must determine whether less severe alternatives to dismissal were considered or appropriate.

issues.label: Findings on prejudice to Century
issues.why: Failure-to-prosecute dismissal typically requires assessment of actual prejudice to the moving party.

issues.label: EH/KAD's culpability or contumacy
issues.why: Whether the delay reflected willful or contumacious conduct warranting the extreme sanction.

issues.label: Adequacy of the record/findings
issues.why: The court's minute order and written order may lack sufficient findings supporting dismissal.

issues.label: Whether warning was given before dismissal
issues.why: Courts often must warn a party of impending dismissal before imposing it.

issues.label: Length and reasons for delay
issues.why: The court must weigh the nearly four-year delay and any explanations EH/KAD offered.

issues.label: Public policy favoring merits resolution
issues.why: Hawaiʻi policy disfavoring dismissal favors deciding cases on their merits.

issues.label: Effect of decision on the briefs
issues.why: Whether deciding without a hearing affected due process or the court's ability to weigh factors.

issues.label: Relevance of pending Century claims
issues.why: Century's own inaction and the still-pending complaint may bear on the failure-to-prosecute finding.

issues.label: Century's own diligence/delay
issues.why: Both parties' inaction during the four years may cut against attributing fault solely to EH/KAD.

issues.label: Absence of court-imposed deadlines
issues.why: Whether EH/KAD violated any scheduling order or pretrial deadline actually in effect.

issues.label: Discrepancy between minute order dates
issues.why: The written order references an April 17, 2024 'Order Granting' though only a minute order issued, raising accuracy concerns.

issues.label: Standard of review of dismissal
issues.why: Rule 41(b) dismissals are reviewed for abuse of discretion, framing appellate scrutiny.

issues.label: Motion for reconsideration standard
issues.why: The court must correctly apply the standard governing reconsideration of the dismissal order.

issues.label: Finality and timeliness of judgment
issues.why: Whether the final judgment and appeal from it are properly before the court.

issues.label: Whether abandonment was established
issues.why: Century characterized inaction as abandonment, which requires a distinct evidentiary showing.

issues.label: Impact of prior remand proceedings
issues.why: The prior appeal and remand may affect what constituted required prosecution steps.
